context: Tests whether the agent classifies a docker.io/bitnamilegacy/* image as stale (the post-September-2025 verdict), flags the urgency (no patches coming), and recommends a per-workload escape that names actual replacements (Docker Official Postgres, CloudNativePG operator, Chainguard) rather than a generic 'Docker Official' pointer.

checklist.name: Classification is stale
checklist.description: image-graph classifies docker.io/bitnamilegacy/postgresql:15.4.0 as tier=stale (NOT free, NOT free-with-caveats, NOT commercial — even though the underlying OS is free Debian, the source-family verdict dominates).

checklist.name: Cites the Bitnami legacy archive context
checklist.description: Report explicitly names the September 2025 Bitnami catalogue retirement OR explains that bitnamilegacy is a frozen archive receiving no patches.

checklist.name: Recommends a per-workload escape
checklist.description: Escape recommendation names at least one of: Docker Official Postgres (`postgres:15` or similar), CloudNativePG operator-managed Postgres, Chainguard `cgr.dev/chainguard/postgres`. Does NOT recommend a generic 'use Docker Official' without naming the specific image.

checklist.name: Urgency flag present
checklist.description: Stale-tier entry is flagged as urgent (e.g. 'Urgent: no patches coming for bitnamilegacy', or equivalent). The urgency is what differentiates stale from commercial.

checklist.name: No fabricated CVE references
checklist.description: Report does NOT cite specific CVE identifiers. The skill classifies license tier, not vulnerability state.
